summary: Writ jurisdiction vs IBC proceedings; High Court improperly interdicted personal insolvency under Section 95 IBC; statutory scheme requires resolution professional to examine debt existence before Adjudicating Authority adjudicates under Section 100; Jiwrajka precedent confirms no judicial determination at appointment stage; High Court prematurely decided waiver issue; proceedings restored to Adjudicating Authority from 16.02.2024 order.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; proceedings restored before Adjudicating Authority from 16.02.2024 order.
